name: Passkey MFA Session Endpoint
summary: Maps password-challenge-bound Passkey MFA completion to the shared Passkey MFA proof service and establishes a browser application session only after the challenge-bound Passkey proof succeeds.

sourceReferences.note: The anonymous browser completion endpoint delegates challenge-bound proof to IPasskeyMfaAuthenticationService and establishes the application session only after a proven AppUser is returned.
